text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Council of ministers discusses developments in the region and reviewed precautionary measures in view of U.S. strikes on Iraq.
- Information Minister Sheikh Saud Nasser al-Sabah says Kuwait is safer than ever. These remarks were covered in most other newspapers.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange trade in August amounts to 2.147 million shares worth 387 million dinars ($1.290 billion).
- Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah says Arab foreign ministers to meet in Cairo to discuss Arab summit decisions. Arab leaders met in June to discuss the Arab-Israeli peace process.
- Deputy speaker's election campaign tent is burned.
